rationale: The expression is internally coherent and correctly signed, but it is a mechanical splice of the archive's best profitability leg (Levered Gross Profit Repair) with the conditioner already tested in R&D-Adjusted Net-Current-Debt Profit, so it will be highly collinear with both and adds little new economic content beyond a leverage-proxy swap.

This is a defensible diagnosis-driven repair of the weak sales-scaled retained-deficit signal (asset scaling plus winsorization stabilizes the noisy margin denominator) and the sign logic is consistent, though a change-in-ROA-times-distress-rank construction is close to well-trodden F-score/distress-conditioning territory and only modestly novel.

Sign direction is internally consistent (rising cost intensity scaled by a strictly positive stress rank predicting negative returns) and it differs from the failed overhead-creep signal on both legs, but note it is close to a sign-flipped, margin-scaled analog of the successful gross-profit-repair signal, so the incremental information may be limited.

The construction is internally inconsistent because multiplying revenue growth by gross margin flips sign for negative-margin firms (shrinking, loss-making firms score positively), and the positive expected sign also sits awkwardly against the well-documented negative sales/asset-growth return relation.

This is essentially a rediscovery: it takes the exact conditioner block of the archive's Deficit Cash-Runway Operating Profit and the exact R&D-adjusted profitability leg of R&D-Adjusted Net-Current-Debt Profit, yielding a cosmetic recombination rather than a new mechanism.

Despite correct sign logic, this is a near-restatement of the already-failed Debt-Rising Operating Decay (delta instead of trend, contribution instead of EBITDA, with a SUMRANK conditioner of the type that previously produced wrong-signed alpha), so it is a cosmetic variant of tested and rejected ground.
